status: provisional observed-title taxonomy; revisions require a new rules version
principles: Main purpose takes precedence over source merchandising department
No original category passed to semantic analyst
General types remain general if title does not specify subtype
Additional uses belong in labels, not invented primary types
category_l2_policy: Derived from the 100 reviewed titles; open candidates, not 15 source departments copied into predictions.

confidence.高: The asserted broad object and usual use are clear; omitted optional attributes do not lower confidence
confidence.中: A broad object is supported, with a material domain/scenario interpretation still needing review
confidence.低: Brand-only, language corruption, polysemy or unresolved primary domain

category_boundaries.首饰盒: 家居日用/首饰收纳, storage function
category_boundaries.钻石画装饰包袋: 服饰配件/包袋 unless title explicitly establishes DIY
category_boundaries.数据线: Do not claim charging where absent from title
category_boundaries.Cazo: Record small-pan/ladle ambiguity rather than assert one vessel
category_boundaries.Barco with brand/series only: Domain hypothesis must not silently become a toy fact
